# MatrixDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Two to four item sets crossed in an L, T, X or Y, a QFD House of Quality, or three at once in a C (cube), cells marked from a scale

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram> CreateMatrixDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram> CreateMatrixDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const MatrixModel& model);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMatrixDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCellClick` | `std::function<void(const MatrixRef&)> onCellClick` | Fired for a populated cell and for an empty one alike; check GetModel().LevelAt(...) to tell them apart. |
| `onCellHover` | `std::function<void(const MatrixRef&)> onCellHover` | _Cell hover_ |
| `onRowClick` | `std::function<void(int panel, int index, const MatrixItem&)> onRowClick` | _Row click_ |
| `onColumnClick` | `std::function<void(int panel, int index, const MatrixItem&)> onColumnClick` | _Column click_ |
| `onCellEdited` | `std::function<void(const MatrixRef&, const std::string& levelId)> onCellEdited` | The new level id, or an empty string when the cell was cleared. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const MatrixRef&)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
| `onSliceClick` | `std::function<void(int panel, int depth, const MatrixItem&)> onSliceClick` | C shape: a depth item's label was clicked - the whole slice. |

## Option types in this header

### enum `MatrixHeaderFit`

How column headers are fitted into the header band. Auto measures the labels once and picks the cheapest form that fits - horizontal if the labels are short enough, then wrapped, then rotated. It never iterates.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Auto` |  |
| `Horizontal` |  |
| `Wrapped` |  |
| `Rotated45` |  |
| `Rotated90` |  |

### enum `MatrixTotals`

Which roll-up gutters are drawn. Row totals sit to the right of the grid, column totals underneath it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoTotals` | named to avoid the X11 'None' macro |
| `Rows` |  |
| `Columns` |  |
| `Both` |  |

### enum `MatrixRollUp`

How the column totals are presented: as numbers in a gutter, or as a strip of bars with each column's rank - the QFD presentation.

| `Bars` |  |

### struct `PanelLayout`

A panel is a lattice: cell (row, col) of the MODEL's row and column sets has its corner at origin + row * rowStep + col * colStep. An L or T steps down the rows and across the columns; an X panel whose model rows lie along a horizontal arm steps the other way round (transposed); a Y panel steps along two seams 120 degrees apart, so its cells are rhombi. Everything below - grid, marks, highlight, hit testing - goes through the lattice, so no shape needs its own copy of them.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `panelIndex` | `int panelIndex = 0` |  |
| `grid` | `Rect2Dd grid` | bounding box of the cell area |
| `origin` | `Point2Dd origin` |  |
| `rowStep` | `Point2Dd rowStep` |  |
| `colStep` | `Point2Dd colStep` |  |
| `axisAligned` | `bool axisAligned = true` |  |
| `upperTriangle` | `bool upperTriangle = false` | a symmetric roof: cells with col &gt; row only |
| `rowLabels` | `Rect2Dd rowLabels` | band left of the grid |
| `colLabels` | `Rect2Dd colLabels` | band above the grid |
| `rowTotals` | `Rect2Dd rowTotals` | gutter right of the grid |
| `colTotals` | `Rect2Dd colTotals` | gutter below the grid |
| `cellWidth` | `double cellWidth = 0.0` |  |
| `cellHeight` | `double cellHeight = 0.0` |  |
| `rows` | `int rows = 0` |  |
| `cols` | `int cols = 0` |  |
| `fit` | `MatrixHeaderFit fit = MatrixHeaderFit::Horizontal` |  |
| `headerLines` | `int headerLines = 1` | for MatrixHeaderFit::Wrapped |
| `rowLabelsOnRight` | `bool rowLabelsOnRight = false` | the left wing of a T |
| `importance` | `Rect2Dd importance` | House of Quality bands, empty elsewhere. row importances, left of the grid |
| `improvementRow` | `Rect2Dd improvementRow` | direction arrows, above the grid |

| `competitive` | `Rect2Dd competitive` | the competitive assessment, right of it |

| `attributes` | `Rect2Dd attributes` | The row set's attribute gutter, between the row labels and the grid (and a House's importance column). Empty elsewhere. |
| `attributeWidths` | `std::vector<double> attributeWidths` | one per MatrixItemSet::columns entry |
| `depth` | `int depth = -1` | A C's slice: the depth item whose cells this lattice draws. -1 for every other shape's panels. |

### struct `ArmLayout`

A band listing one item set, used by the X and Y shapes, where the labels of a set serve two panels and so belong to neither. Item i occupies origin + dir * [i, i+1] * itemSize, across * [0, bandWidth].

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `setIndex` | `int setIndex = -1` |  |
| `origin` | `Point2Dd origin` |  |
| `dir` | `Point2Dd dir` | unit: the way the items run |
| `across` | `Point2Dd across` | unit: across the band |
| `itemSize` | `double itemSize = 0.0` |  |
| `bandWidth` | `double bandWidth = 0.0` |  |
| `count` | `int count = 0` |  |
| `itemsAreColumns` | `bool itemsAreColumns = false` | X's left/right arms |
| `fit` | `MatrixHeaderFit fit = MatrixHeaderFit::Horizontal` |  |
| `headerLines` | `int headerLines = 1` |  |
| `titleAnchor` | `Point2Dd titleAnchor` | centre of the set title |
| `titleVertical` | `bool titleVertical = false` |  |
